THE GHOSTS OF 1941 ARE BACK. 🇯🇵🚫

While the world was looking away, Japan just SHATTERED 80 years of peace. PM Takaichi has officially killed the "Peace Constitution" without asking a single citizen.

They aren't just defending anymore—they’re DEALING. Japan is now an international ARMS DEALER, flooding 17 countries with lethal warships and tanks.

What they aren't telling you:
⚠️ Japan is building a "Web of War" across Asia.
⚠️ Your tax dollars/security are being traded for "Strategic Alliances."
⚠️ The "Type 25" missile isn't for defense—it’s a reach-out-and-touch-someone weapon.

From the UK to the Philippines, Japan is arming the world and poking the bear in the East Sea. Is this "deterrence" or are we being dragged into World War III?

The peaceful Japan we knew is DEAD. 🕊️💀

#WWIII #Japan  #Militarism
